svg.title: Transcoding a 2-hour film: one worker versus 600 parallel tasks
svg.desc: Top: on a 0 to 40 minute axis, one 16-core worker takes about 37 minutes while the parallel pipeline takes about 2.5. Bottom, zoomed to 3 minutes: the split takes 30 seconds, 600 encode tasks of about a minute each run side by side, one task fails and is retried on its own, then packaging writes the manifests and the video is ready.
svg.text: one 2-hour film, 5 renditions = 36,000 core-seconds of work
